HOW MOSAIC WORKS

One loop that learns your channel.

Analyze what happened, discover what's repeating, create the next one, and feed the result back in. One memory connects every stage: your Creative DNA.

Creative DNA is the memory that connects every stage — it compounds, it never resets.

GETTING STARTED

Connect your first video in three steps.

1

Paste a TikTok link

Mosaic pulls the video, transcript, and live performance data automatically.

PATTERN ENGINE

How patterns get discovered and scored.

Every analyzed video is checked against your existing pattern library. When a mechanism repeats across multiple distinct videos, Mosaic keeps it as evidence — never from a single guess.

Detected counts how many separate videos support a pattern. Confidence reflects how much evidence backs it. Performance lift compares videos with the pattern against your average.

ENTITIES

Every brand, place, and person — indexed.

Mosaic extracts named entities from every video: brands, cities, people, products, and more. Ask which videos mention a competitor or a specific place, and get an instant answer.

Video Ideas

Turn your pattern library into ready-to-shoot concepts for a specific campaign. Most people scroll past 200+ ideas a day...without ever writing one down. This page is for the ones worth keeping.

Generate a new batch

GENERATED FOR "BACK TO SCHOOL" — 3 OF 10

"The 60-Second Dorm Reset"

Screenshot Proof

Open on a messy dorm desk, screenshot-style text overlay counts down "60 seconds," fast cuts show the kit being used, ends on the finished setup with a satisfied reaction shot.

Hook: Countdown timerLength: ~18sPredicted lift: +24%
Why this works

Matches "Screenshot Proof" pattern — 92% confidence, +41% engagement lift across 124 observations. Countdown format creates urgency without feeling like an ad.

"POV: Your Skin Before First Period"

Relatable Micro Moment

POV-style, handheld camera, a student checking their skin in a phone camera before the first day back, relatable internal monologue text overlay, quick product application, confident walk-out shot.

Hook: POV text overlayLength: ~15sPredicted lift: +18%
Why this works

Matches "Relatable Micro Moment" — 85% confidence. First-person framing consistently outperforms third-person product shots for this audience.

"Locker Room Product Swap"

Pattern Interrupt

Cold open mid-conversation between two friends, one interrupts to show the product, quick contrast cut to "before" reaction, ends on a locker-door close for a snappy button.

Hook: Mid-conversation interruptLength: ~12sPredicted lift: +15%
Why this works

Matches "Pattern Interrupt (Hook)" — 82% confidence, detected in 140 videos. Cold-open interrupts consistently stop the scroll in the first second.

Contrast-driven storytelling increases retention

Videos that set up a clear "before" state retain viewers 22% longer on average.

Confirmed

Real people outperform stock-style footage

Unscripted, handheld framing consistently beats polished studio shots for this audience.

Confirmed

Silence before the offer builds anticipation

A brief pause (0.5-1s) right before the call-to-action correlates with higher completion.

Emerging

Text overlays should change every 2-3 seconds

Static on-screen text held longer than 3 seconds shows a measurable attention drop.
